_comment: Level tables and kart rules. 'source' says where a number comes from: 'datamined' = MK8 Deluxe game data via Super Mario Wiki; 'official' = Nintendo tutorial timings; 'provisional' = placeholder to be replaced by measurements from 60 fps captures of MK8 Deluxe.

speed_ground.source: provisional, narrowed from 19.5..27 to balance against mini-turbo (docs/BALANCE.md)

speed_water.source: datamined Float_SpdMaxFwd = Drive_SpdMaxFwd: the water table equals the ground one, parts' water points make the spread; values provisional, narrowed with speed_ground

acceleration.source: datamined Drive_AccLmtFwd; scale to m/s^2 provisional

traction.unit: 0..1 slip resistance on sand and ice

mt_thresholds.source: datamined (MK8 Wii U) for blue and orange; purple provisional

offroad_light.source: datamined BrakeRt_DIRT light, used as a top-speed multiplier (interpretation provisional)

constants._glide: provisional, tuned by feel: height and speed are one budget. The nose commands the path angle (sine units); glide_gravity pulls along it against a drag that balances it at the air speed stat, where the glider sinks at 1/glide_ratio of its speed. Speed stays between glide_floor x air speed and glide_cap_mult x top speed; near the floor the nose drops by itself instead of stalling.
constants._water: underwater (deep water zones), all provisional: gravity scale and fall cap while airborne, the stick's pull on the sink (half the glider's), drift turn scale, frames before the mode flips

trick_min_air_frames.source: provisional: a trick off a lip or crest needs a fifth of a second of air to pay out

trick_chain_frames.source: provisional: tricks chain 150 ms apart; the boost is paid once on landing

trick_max_height.source: provisional: a trick works anywhere in the air up to this many metres above the road (not gliding, underwater or off a drift hop)

crest_stick.source: provisional, tuned by feel: a crest throws the kart off when speed^2 x the road's bend beats this many g (1.0 would be real; the tracks' hills top out near 0.75 g at full speed)

crest_carry.source: provisional: off a crest the kart keeps the climb the road had this many metres back

constants._grip: provisional, tuned by feel: grip road (steep banks and spirals). A descent raises top speed by grip_descent_gain per unit of downward slope (a 15-degree drop gives about 13%); that speed bleeds off at grip_carry_decel m/s^2 for grip_carry_frames after leaving the stretch; drifts charge mini-turbos grip_charge_mult times faster on it.
constants._suspension: provisional, tuned by feel: a sprung body over the ground contact. Pairs run lightest to heaviest by the weight Level. Compression in metres (+ down), angles in radians. Only the landing wobble (steering lost after bottoming out) touches driving.
constants._two_wheels: provisional, tuned by feel: sideways force (m/s^2) past the threshold, lightest to heaviest, tips the kart onto its outside wheels. Visual only.
